general-purpose subagent (Claude), separate context — confirmed the double-count is real (CloudWatch aggregates, not dedupes) and the exclusivity fix loses nothing for Logs Insights

records.finding: With a putter configured, ExportMetrics wrote EMF metric records AND called PutMetricData for the same batch. The default writer is os.Stdout (agent-extracted), so this double-counts every metric — CloudWatch aggregates same name+dims+timestamp points, it does not dedupe. The package/WithMetricPutter docs contradicted (alternative vs in-addition).
records.evidence: if err := e.writeMetricRecords(batch); err != nil { return err }; if e.putter != nil { return e.putMetricData(ctx, batch) }
records.reason: The putter now REPLACES the EMF metric path (exactly one metric path runs): ExportMetrics calls putMetricData when a putter is set, else writeMetricRecords. Outcome events always take the writer (PutMetricData cannot carry them; event records declare no metric, so nothing is lost for Logs Insights). Docs corrected; TestPutMetricDataReplacesEMFMetricRecords asserts only the event record reaches the writer when a putter is set.

records.finding: The maxDatums=1000 chunking loop in putMetricData had its multi-chunk branch untested — the only putter test sent 2 datums and asserted 1 call, so the boundary math was unverified.
records.evidence: for start := 0; start < len(datums); start += maxDatums { end := start + maxDatums; if end > len(datums) { end = len(datums) } ... datums[start:end] }
records.reason: Added TestPutMetricDataChunksAtServiceLimit (table-driven: 1000 -> [1000], 1001 -> [1000,1], 2500 -> [1000,1000,500]) asserting exact chunk sizes and that the datum total is preserved (no loss or duplication).
